limitations: Presence of at least one source archive is not all-time historical completeness.
Verified closed months, native daily bars, and additional Release backfills are different catalogs; do not silently add or deduplicate them.
Year-depth index is a separate Binance-only historical snapshot and may cover different months than federation; its counts are not added to federal minute counts.
No source ZIP/release byte was re-downloaded and independently SHA-256 replayed in this reconciliation; trusted published indexes are enumerated by Git blob SHA.
No inferred token inception or first exchange trade time; native daily source observed gaps are source-reported, not inferred trade outages.
No cross-exchange or quote substitution, no bar interpolation, no live price certification, and no automatic Trader activation.
